param p1 = 14 in [5, 42]
param p2 = 0.03 in [0.0075, 0.12]
param p3 = 0.5 in [0.1875, 0.5]

let r = rsi(close, p1)
enter_long when crossover(r, 30)
exit_long when crossover(r, 70)
set stop_loss = p2
set size = p3

param p1 = 5 in [2, 15]
param p2 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p3 = 300 in [100, 900]
param p4 = 300 in [100, 900]

enter_long when crossover(open, sma(close, p1))
exit_long when close - sma(close, p2) > 0.61 * atr(p3) and rsi(close, p4) < 30
set stop_loss = 0.0504
set take_profit = 0.1459

param p1 = 50 in [17, 150]
param p2 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p3 = -0.0299 in [-0.04784, -0.01196]
param p4 = 0.0217 in [0.005425, 0.0868]

enter_long when crossunder(rsi(close, p1), 31)
exit_long when roc(close, p2) > p3
set stop_loss = p4

param p1 = 300 in [100, 900]
param p2 = 50 in [17, 150]
param p3 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p4 = 20 in [7, 60]

enter_long when roc(close, p1) > 0.018 and close - sma(close, p2) < 1.68 * atr(p3)
exit_long when rsi(close, p4) < 85 and crossunder(lowest(low, 5), ema(close, 50))
set take_profit = 0.1384
set trail_stop = 0.0823

param p1 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p2 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p3 = -0.0276 in [-0.04416, -0.01104]
param p4 = 0.0281 in [0.01124, 0.04496]

enter_long when roc(close, p1) < p3
exit_long when roc(close, p2) < p4

param p1 = 200 in [67, 600]
param p2 = 5 in [2, 15]
param p3 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p4 = 0.0151 in [0.003775, 0.0604]

enter_long when crossunder(rsi(close, p1), 54)
exit_long when ema(close, p2) > sma(close, p3)
set stop_loss = p4

param p1 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p2 = 100 in [33, 300]
param p3 = 0.02 in [0.005, 0.08]

let f = sma(close, p1)
let s = sma(close, p2)
enter_long when crossover(f, s)
exit_long when crossunder(f, s)
set stop_loss = p3

param p1 = 5 in [2, 15]
param p2 = 13 in [4, 39]
param p3 = 0.0126 in [0.00315, 0.0504]
param p4 = 0.0423 in [0.010575, 0.1692]

enter_long when crossover(rsi(close, p1), 17)
exit_long when crossover(high, sma(close, p2))
set stop_loss = p3
set trail_stop = p4

param p1 = 300 in [100, 900]
param p2 = 13 in [4, 39]
param p3 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p4 = -0.0198 in [-0.03168, -0.00792]

enter_long when roc(close, p1) > p4
exit_long when crossover(ema(close, p2), sma(close, p3))
set stop_loss = 0.0181

param p1 = 120 in [40, 360]
param p2 = 14 in [5, 42]
param p3 = 2 in [2, 3]
param p4 = 120 in [40, 360]

let hi_ch = highest(high, p1)
let vol = atr(p2)
enter_long when close > delay(hi_ch, p3)
exit_long when crossunder(close, sma(close, p4))
set trail_stop = 3 * vol / close

param p1 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p2 = 200 in [67, 600]
param p3 = 300 in [100, 900]
param p4 = 5 in [2, 15]

enter_long when sma(close, p1) < high or roc(close, p2) > (-0.01)
exit_long when rsi(close, p3) < 51 and open < high and close - sma(close, p4) < 2.61 * atr(200)
set stop_loss = 0.0441
set take_profit = 0.0401

param p1 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p2 = 50 in [17, 150]
param p3 = 0.0048 in [0.00192, 0.00768]
param p4 = 25 in [10, 40]

enter_long when roc(close, p1) < p3
exit_long when rsi(close, p2) > p4
set trail_stop = 0.0758
